task.task_name: Implement CLI poll decrypt history and ack state machine
task.description: Implement inbound mailbox transport, trusted native decrypt, encrypted monotonic history and durable post-commit acknowledgement APIs required by ten independent RED tests.
acceptance_criteria: RelayClient strictly implements challenge, poll and ack response/request contracts with the existing timeout/redaction guarantees.
Mailbox challenge/create/poll/ack signatures use the stable local device identity derived only inside the encrypted profile boundary.
Envelope recipient and imported sender pins plus strict ciphertext wrapper are checked before native mutation.
Native decrypt/session/prekey changes, inbox deduplication, pending ack and inbound history commit atomically.
Ack happens only after commit; timeout/restart retries only ack and never decrypts or duplicates history.
Exact redelivery under a new envelope is acked without decrypt; changed ciphertext under the same message id fails closed.
Outbound plaintext history is added atomically with session/outbox before HTTP and all history stays encrypted/offline/chronological.
All ten supplied T25 tests and prior workspace tests/typechecks pass unchanged.
task.context: Follow inbound.test.ts exactly. Reuse the T24 ciphertext wire: base64url UTF-8 strict JSON {version:1,type:number,body:canonical-base64url}; pass outer message_id to SignalClient.decrypt so the authenticated payload binds it. Add shared history helpers with a transaction-local monotonic sequence and keys under cli:history:. Store an inbox ciphertext hash to distinguish exact redelivery from changed content and pending ack records keyed by envelope. Derive local mailbox signatures from the encrypted profile seed/device identity without returning private material. Extend RelayClient through its bounded strict request boundary. Repository is unborn main; no commits.
task.module_patterns: ESM strict TypeScript, Zod strict schemas, injected RelayClient, serialized runtime operations, caller-owned EncryptedSqliteStore transaction and official libsignal.

test_case_specs.run_command: cd apps/cli && pnpm exec vitest run src/runtime/inbound.test.ts
